description: CPD-10 assigned item 4 (CPD10-60, CPD10-61): a child run's spec, pin included, exactly as Node's admission and ChildRunService.spawn produce it under CONTROL_PLANE_PIN=on for a migrated org whose agent's owner shared a skill through the agent. Written by backend/nodejs/apps/tests/modules/agent-harness/cpd10-child-owner.test.ts (WRITE_CHILD_OWNER_VECTORS=1) and compared there otherwise; read by backend/python/tests/unit/harness/pinning/test_cpd10_child_owner.py, which feeds each `spec` to the production assembler. `skill` is the skill the owner authored: `bundleDigest` is its content digest as the worker's skill store computes it for `body` (the Python test holds that), and is what the installation approves and the spec pins. `owner`: the child's parent was admitted for a colleague of the agent's owner; `no-owner`: the same, with a definition that names no owner.
